evidence.quote: If any nodes are unhealthy for more than 45 minutes, Amazon EMR will [gracefully replace the nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-scaledown-behavior.html#emr-scaledown-terminate-task).

If unhealthy node replacement is turned on, Amazon EMR terminates an unhealthy core node and provisions a new instance, based on the number of instances in the instance group, or based on the target capacity for instance fleets.
Note that the time it takes before a node is gracefully decommissioned or terminated can be subject to change.

claim: If unhealthy node replacement is turned on and any nodes are unhealthy for more than 45 minutes, Amazon EMR will gracefully replace the nodes; the time it takes before a node is gracefully decommissioned or terminated can be subject to change.

qualifiers.scope: unhealthy core nodes of an EMR cluster with unhealthy node replacement turned on
qualifiers.condition: unhealthy node replacement is turned on
